title: The Bread and Flour (Amendment) (England) Regulations 2024
authors: Secretary of State for Health and Social Care, UK Government
journal: UK Statutory Instruments 2024 No. 1162, legislation.gov.uk, made 13 November 2024
result: Amends the Bread and Flour Regulations 1998 to require folic acid (pteroylmonoglutamic acid) at 0.250 mg per 100 g of common wheat flour, alongside calcium carbonate, iron, thiamin and niacin, from 13 December 2026; wholemeal flour and flour from small mills producing under 500 tonnes a year are exempt. The Secretary of State had regard to advice from the Food Standards Agency. Stocks placed on the market or labelled before 13 December 2026 may be sold until exhausted.
